notes.title: Bubsy Patch is now LIVE
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,
Although the version number was unintentionally not updated - the current version was patched yesteday.

Fixes:
DX should not cause crash errors on machines with intergrated graphics cards - this was especially an issue wirh Intel cards - but this issue should be univerally resolved.

If you are still expierencing any technical issues please contact info@accoladegame.com and include the MiniDump file found in the Bubsy Steam folder on your local drive.

I told them to make an Atari 2600 version and they just wouldn't listen!

B
